lines.t: Verse 1
Storm’s breaking, shadows try to pull me under
Whispers in the night, but I’m running like thunder
Fear’s rising up, but Your name is my armor
Every step I take, You make me stronger
Pre-Chorus
I hear the lies trying to chain me down
But Your truth cuts through every sound
When the world shakes, I won’t bow
You lift me up, I’m standing now
Chorus
When the battle hits, I stand in the fire
’Cause You’re the One who lifts me higher
Every weapon formed will fall at Your feet
Your light breaks in — and it rescues me
I’m unbroken, unafraid, set free
I rise again where Your light finds me
Verse 2
Winds howl, but Your peace is louder
Dark tries to drown me, but You’ve got the power
No turning back, I’m a new creation
Moving in the strength of Your salvation
Pre-Chorus
I hear the doubt trying to drag me down
But Your love shakes the battleground
When the night hits, I won’t hide
You pull me through to the other side
Chorus
When the battle hits, I stand in the fire
’Cause You’re the One who lifts me higher
Every weapon formed will fall at Your feet
Your light breaks in — and it rescues me
I’m unbroken, unafraid, set free
I rise again where Your light finds me
I won’t run
I won’t break
You are the light no darkness can take
In the storm
In the flames
You call my heart by my name
When the battle hits, I stand in the fire
’Cause You’re the One who lifts me higher
Every fear I had is lost in Your peace
Your voice calls out — and it strengthens me
I’m unbroken, unafraid, set free
I rise again where Your light finds me
